title: FRPP examples migrated from emhawkes
code: tz_law <- residual_law(c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6),   density = emhawkes::dtzexp, cdf = emhawkes::ptzexp,   quantile = emhawkes::qtzexp, rng = emhawkes::rtzexp, name = "tzexp") model_1d <- fspec(   methods::new("hspec", mu = 0.5, alpha = 1, beta = 1.2), tz_law) set.seed(1107) path_1d <- fsim(model_1d, size = 3000, lambda_component0 = 0) seed_1d <- .Random.seed inferred_1d <- logLik(model_1d, path_1d$inter_arrival,   lambda_component0 = 0, infer = TRUE) state_1d <- if (has_kernel_api) logLik(model_1d, path_1d$inter_arrival,   lambda_component0 = 0, infer = TRUE, backend = "state") else NULL c(bridge = inferred_1d$loglikelihood,   state = if (has_kernel_api) state_1d$loglikelihood else NA_real_) #>   bridge    state  #> 1114.393       NA hist(inferred_1d$res_process1, breaks = 100, probability = TRUE,   main = "One-dimensional FRPP residuals", xlab = "Residual") curve(emhawkes::dtzexp(x, a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), add = TRUE, col = "red")

what: Compare the original and migrated examples
title: FRPP examples migrated from emhawkes
text: reference objects use original representation. Compare every simulation field final RNG state exactly. bridge must return inference result. Independent state calculations use fixed numerical comparison tolerance 1e-10; absolute differences also reported.
code: reference_1d <- emhawkes::set_residual(   methods::new("hspec", mu = 0.5, alpha = 1, beta = 1.2),   param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), dresidual = emhawkes::dtzexp,   presidual = emhawkes::ptzexp, qresidual = emhawkes::qtzexp,   rresidual = emhawkes::rtzexp) reference_2d <- emhawkes::set_residual(   methods::new("hspec", mu = c(0.3, 0.3),     alpha = matrix(c(0.5, 0.8, 0.8, 0.5), 2, byrow = TRUE),     beta = matrix(1.5, 2, 2)),   param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), dresidual = emhawkes::dtzexp,   presidual = emhawkes::ptzexp, qresidual = emhawkes::qtzexp,   rresidual = emhawkes::rtzexp) reference_uniform <- methods::new("hspec", mu = c(0.5, 0.5),   alpha = matrix(0.3, 2, 2), beta = matrix(1.2, 2, 2),   rresidual = function(size) runif(n = size, 0, 2),   dresidual = function(x, param = numeric(0), log = FALSE) dunif(x, 0, 2, log = log),   presidual = function(q, param = numeric(0), lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)     punif(q, 0, 2, lower.tail = lower.tail, log.p = log.p),   qresidual = function(p, param = numeric(0), lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)     qunif(p, 0, 2, lower.tail = lower.tail, log.p = log.p)) compare_example <- function(reference, path, seed_after, bridge, state) {   set.seed(1107)   old <- emhawkes::hsim(reference, size = length(path$type), lambda_component0 = 0)   fields <- setdiff(names(old), "hspec")   stopifnot(identical(unclass(path)[fields], unclass(old)[fields]),     identical(.Random.seed, seed_after))   expected <- emhawkes::logLik(reference, old$inter_arrival, old$type,     mark = old$mark, lambda_component0 = 0, infer = TRUE)   stopifnot(identical(bridge, expected))   shared <- names(expected)   if (!is.null(state)) stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(state[shared], expected, tolerance = 1e-10)))   data.frame(rows = length(path$type), simulation_exact = TRUE, rng_exact = TRUE,     bridge_exact = TRUE,     state_loglik_difference = if (is.null(state)) NA_real_ else state$loglikelihood - expected$loglikelihood,     maximum_state_output_difference = if (is.null(state)) NA_real_ else max(vapply(shared, function(nm)       if (length(expected[[nm]])) max(abs(state[[nm]] - expected[[nm]])) else 0,       numeric(1)))) } comparison <- rbind(   tzexp_1d = compare_example(reference_1d, path_1d, seed_1d, inferred_1d, state_1d),   tzexp_2d = compare_example(reference_2d, path_2d, seed_2d, inferred_2d, state_2d),   uniform_2d = compare_example(reference_uniform, path_uniform, seed_uniform,     inferred_uniform, state_uniform)) comparison #>             rows simulation_exact rng_exact bridge_exact #> tzexp_1d    3000             TRUE      TRUE         TRUE #> tzexp_2d   10000             TRUE      TRUE         TRUE #> uniform_2d  5000             TRUE      TRUE         TRUE #>            state_loglik_difference maximum_state_output_difference #> tzexp_1d                        NA                              NA #> tzexp_2d                        NA                              NA #> uniform_2d                      NA                              NA
